#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

vector<long long> fact, invFact;

long long mod_inv(long long a) {
    long long g = MOD, x = 0, y = 1;
    for (long long r = a; r != 0; ) {
        long long q = g / r;
        g %= r;
        long long temp = g;
        g = r;
        r = temp;
        x -= q * y;
        temp = x;
        x = y;
        y = temp;
    }
    // g should be 1
    x %= MOD;
    if (x < 0) x += MOD;
    return x;
}

void precompute_fact_inv(int n) {
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    invFact.resize(n + 1);
    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD;
    }
    invFact[n] = mod_inv(fact[n]);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
        invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % MOD;
    }
}

long long ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
    return fact[n] * invFact[r] % MOD * invFact[n - r] % MOD;
}

long long smallInv(int x) {
    // x >= 1
    return invFact[x] * fact[x - 1] % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    int maxN = n + m;
    precompute_fact_inv(maxN);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; ; ++i) {
        p = p * (n - i) % MOD * smallInv(n + m - i) % MOD;
        phaseSize = (phaseSize + p) % MOD;
        if (p == 0) break;
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
        long long numPhases = (m + k) * smallInv(k) % MOD;
        long long e = numPhases * phaseSize % MOD;
        long long term = ncr(n, k) * e % MOD;
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            answer = (answer + term) % MOD;
        } else {
            answer = (answer - term + MOD) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << answer << endl;

    return 0;
}
